name: stamp-new-tool
title: New Tool
description: Creates a non-Stamp Tool at a flat or nested semantic House path. Can inherit a nearest-parent executor and register a flat PATHS address.

settings.name: path
settings.title: Semantic Path
settings.description: Optional tools-root relative semantic path such as audit/find/todos. When supplied it determines domain and leaf name.

settings.name: type
settings.title: Type
settings.description: Domain folder for legacy flat creation when path is omitted.

settings.name: name
settings.title: Name
settings.description: Leaf Tool name for legacy flat creation when path is omitted.

settings.name: address
settings.title: House Address
settings.description: Optional flat PATHS key. Defaults from the semantic path, for example audit/find/todos -> find-todos.

settings.name: inherit_executor
settings.title: Inherit Executor
settings.description: When true, create only the semantic leaf settings and require a nearest-parent executor instead of creating a leaf executor.

settings.name: settings
settings.title: Run Settings
settings.description: Inputs for running the generated Tool.
